decision_reasons: The previously chosen additive variant passes all112 development validation gates; zero_only fails38 validation gates and does not address systematic baseline mean underprediction outside zero volume.
All13 additive development holdout failures are retained as measured regressions. This decision does not relabel them as passed or prove they are sampling noise.

The already planned final estimator merges mean sufficient statistics across all64 independent calibration cohorts before any qualification holdout exposure, retaining cohort-local medians and intervals.
Larger calibration support changes shrinkage weights and may improve generalization, but does not prove that the final MSE or bias gates will pass.
Do not select seeds, enlarge the sample after exposure, loosen thresholds, refit on qualification holdouts, or mark ready without every frozen gate and independent replay.

descriptor.evaluation_scope: Independent synthetic qualification holdouts only; portfolio final test remains unopened.
descriptor.sample_rule: All 64 seeds, fixed before generation. No exclusions, replacements, or sample enlargement after exposure.
descriptor.source_runtime_scope: Final source runtime must include the measured import closure and be installed with pinned constraints; AI numerical dependencies are separately locked and verified.
